item.title: Rezaei fires back at US ‘civilizational war’ narrative with reminder of Rome’s defeat
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Major General Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council (SNSC), has invoked the ancient defeat of Rome by Sasanian king Shapur I to counter an attempt by US officials to frame the aggression against Iran as a civilizational war.

Tehran, IRNA – Major General Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council (SNSC), has invoked the ancient defeat of Rome by Sasanian king Shapur I to counter an attempt by US officials to frame the aggression against Iran as a civilizational war.

item.title: Iran slams French president’s double standard on nuclear deterrence
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s Foreign Ministry spokesperson has criticized the French president over a blatant double standard on nuclear deterrence, questioning why the same logic that France views as guaranteeing its security and freedom suddenly turns into a “threat” when it comes to Iran.
